summary: Verified the new full-page Self-Assessment (Card 1 redo). Added /app/backend/tests/test_self_assessment_ai.py (9 tests, incl. 3 live Claude calls) — all pass. Regression test_self_assessment.py + test_self_assessment_reminders.py (8 tests) still pass. Frontend end-to-end flow on desktop 1920x1080 as parent1@test.com confirms: self-assessment-page opens in data-mode='assess' (parent1 has a draft, resumes at Step 2 / Question 1 of 5), with pill 'STEP 2 OF 6', journey step statuses reflect=current / identify|goals|track=upcoming, all chrome testids present (sa-safety-banner, sa-safety-911=tel:911, sa-safety-dv=tel:18007997233, sa-emergent-badge, sa-back, sa-quick-exit-desktop, sa-step-pill, sa-journey-steps, sa-ai-panel, sa-bottom-banner), question panel (sa-question-title='Question 1 of 5 · Step 2: My Self-Awareness', sa-question-prompt, sa-step-num=2, self-assessment-save-status='Saved to your account', sa-back-question='Change my last answer', sa-option-1..5). AI framing round-trip works (sa-ai-query → sa-ai-submit → sa-ai-framing / -advice / -suggested / -copy with real Claude). AI Examples and Templates open sa-ai-library with all 6 expected testids and library text contains 'grey-rock' as expected for parent1. sa-ai-biff hides the page (display:none) and Escape restores it (display:block). sa-back closes the overlay and returns to Self Journey with the Card 1 still visible.
verified: POST /api/self-assessment/ai/tip: incomplete section → 400 'Please finish this step first.'; unknown section → 400 'Unknown step.'; overall with only one section → 400; missing section → 422; live Claude call with full child_focus answers returns non-empty tip (no quotes).
POST /api/self-assessment/ai/framing: text<3 → 422; missing text → 422; live Claude call returns {advice, suggested} both strings; safety_flagged=true live call returns same shape (grey-rock voice).

Frontend: Card 1 click opens full-page self-assessment-page portal, correct data-mode & resume-at-Step 2 behaviour, header does not overlap (portal z-50 covers full viewport), AI framing + examples/templates + BIFF drawer hide/show + sa-back close all work end-to-end as spec'd.
critical_code_review_comments: self_assessment_ai.py: _ask raises HTTPException(502) on provider error but AiInsightPanel/useSaInsight should surface this clearly in sa-ai-error. The user-facing text 'The AI guide couldn't respond right now.' is good; confirmed sa-ai-error exists on the panel.

/api/self-assessment/ai/tip truncates tip to 600 chars via slicing after strip — fine, but note the slice happens after joining with single spaces so word boundaries may be cut mid-word in extreme cases. Not seen in practice (Claude replies well under 600 chars for 2 sentences).
_grey_rock reads user flag via is_safety_flagged every call — adds one DB roundtrip per AI call. Acceptable given rate guard, but could be cached per-request if traffic grows.
seed_data_creation: No seed data created. Used parent1's existing in-progress draft (Section 1 answered, Step 2 current).
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_self_assessment_ai.py covers validation + live Claude for both /tip and /framing endpoints. BASE_URL fallback reads /app/frontend/.env if REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env var isn't set in the pytest process. For live tests, timeout=45s is used (Claude typically responds in 3-8s). The dashboard shows a LegalAcknowledgment modal on first visit after login — dismiss via data-testid=legal-ack-checkbox then legal-ack-continue-button before any Self Journey navigation.
